about_the_game:
Slot Racing: a hypnotic dance between you and the rail

🏁 Speed Rivals is a fast-paced slot racing game where precision and strategy make the difference.

🚗 Compete on frenetic tracks inspired by the golden age of Slot Racing, upgrade your vehicles and climb the ranks in tournaments to become the best driver. 🏆 With an immersive story mode 📖, a competitive multiplayer 🛣️, and a zen mode 😴 in case you need to relax 😴.

Every turn is a challenge and every win a step closer to the top - do you have what it takes to dominate the track? 🔥🏎️

🏁Fast-paced and strategic competition

High-speed races where precision is everything. Master acceleration, braking, and counterbalance to avoid derailing on sharp turns and stay in the fight for victory. Each track is designed to challenge your skills, offering an intense and thrilling experience.

🏎️Wide selection of cars and advanced customization

Over 50 unique vehicles, ranging from entry-level models to elite racing machines. Upgrade key components like the engine, tires, transmission, and turbo to optimize performance and adapt to different tracks and driving styles.

🛣️ Legendary tracks and track editor

Race on circuits inspired by iconic slot car tracks, featuring technical turns, high-speed straights, and challenging sections. Plus, the track editor lets you design and share your own custom tracks, fine-tuning every detail to create unique challenges.

📖 Story mode with progression and tournaments

Follow the journey of a rookie driver striving to make a name in the slot racing world. Compete in tournaments, earn reputation, unlock new cars, and prove you have what it takes to reach the top.

🧘 Zen mode for practice and exploration

A stress-free mode where you can drive freely, with no time limits or rivals. Perfect for honing your skills, testing upgrades, and exploring track details at your own pace.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.9 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX650 or AMD equivalent
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

  • OS: Ubuntu 20 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 4 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX1050 or AMD equivalent
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
